args.body: The latest host projection lists six committed files under products/services/sqlite-repair/original-fixture/verified-handoff/. If SQLITE-ORIGINAL-FIXTURE-SELLER-PACKAGE is still unfinished, read those committed files under a valid lease. Check manifest hashes, report status, expected_match, statement counts, the unexecuted tail, and cleanup directly in both reports. Preserve the earlier INVALID_CASE run as evidence that exit code alone is insufficient. If the handoff meets the mission goal, close with the actual lease, file paths, and a lesson covering what worked, what failed, and what to check first next time. Reuse an existing closure. No public release.

description: Treasury shows zero verified available funds and zero verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available as unverified interpretation, with no classified signals and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The newly committed SQLite handoff gives us a concrete deliverable to verify. Its commercial test is whether a buyer will pay for a diagnosis and verified correction on their own case when the free download already supports self-service. An eligible inquiry would justify a provisional quote. Operator acceptance and Treasury settlement remain separate.
